title: Ye That Obey Th' Immortal King
description: Ye That Obey Th' Immortal King in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 134, headed “Daily and nightly devotion”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Ye that o-bey th'im-mor-tal King, At-tend his ho-ly place, Bow to the glo-ries of his power, And bless his won-drous grace;

lines: Ye that obey th' immortal King,
Bow to the glories of his power,
Lift up your hands by morning-light,
And send your souls on high;
Raise your admiring thoughts by night
The God of Zion cheers our hearts
The God that spread the heavens abroad,

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
